notes.title: 3 Astronomical Game Updates & Daily Deal!
notes.content:
[h3]One small step for man, one giant leap for Filament:

As we embark on our very first Steam daily deal!

Come grab: 

The deluxe Marmalade Edition - 25% off
The base game - 25% off
& the Soundtrack - 20% off!

To coincide with this announcement, we also have 3 astronomical game updates!

1st up: [u]a hint system![/u]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/88eacae87ff9d0a03e8aa2f1d45ce3140355e7e3.png[/img]


At the press of a button, the next pillar or a prior pillar mistake will be highlighted in two different colours.

To use strategically either in the later puzzles or early on whilst getting to grips with the game mechanics: this new feature will become a starry support for streamers & gamers alike.

Next up & due to popular demand:

[u]You can now re-listen to all voice logs from Juniper herself![/u]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/7ed002e89813d6afe301859c5a1f386403af0d3e.png[/img]


Simply use the new voice recordings tab in the terminal to access the voice acting you've already heard.

Last & by no means least, for our final Filament-al announcement:

[u]Our game is now available in Brazilian Portuguese![/u]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/111a628524cae851a030e64b5d5180cabbd00714.png[/img]


You can select the language in the options menu, after you update the game.

Join us on [url=www.twitter.com/FilamentPuzzle]Twitter[/url], [url=www.facebook.com/KasedoGames]Facebook[/url],[url=www.instagram.com/KasedoGames] Instagram[/url] &[url=discord.gg/FilamentPuzzle] Discord [/url]as we announce the three major updates along with exclusive game previews & images.

Over & out![/h3]

notes.title: Filament Bug Fixes & Updates - 24th April 2020
notes.content:
First of all:

Thank you to those who told us about these game bugs & reported them to us on both here on Steam community & on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/filamentpuzzle]Discord. [/url]

You make our cosmic game that much better by doing so, so thank you!  

So here's our Filament Hotfix for 24/04/2020:

- Fixed the rare bug that yeets player into space.
- Fixed the cable that wasn't lighting up in requisite 8.
- Fixed the options menu not correctly detecting resolution.
- Fixed the terminal not unlocking when tabbing out as terminal launches.
- Fixed the terminal transparency sorting issue.
- Fixed the log numbers displaying wrong in different languages.
- Fixed the issue with Opus 3 anchor not begin accessible after using ladder.
- Fixed the issue getting stuck behind anchor in medbay.
- Fixed the collision on requisite 5.
- Archways now make a noise when you pass through them.
- Fixed the visual issues in living room.
- Fixed the visual issues in kitchen.
- Fixed the archways not closing an already open door when you overload them.
- Fixed the wrapping pillars not closing an already open door when you overload them.
- Fixed formatting issues in messages when viewing in Japanese.

Speak to you soon, Operatives!

notes.title: Korean Now Added!
notes.content:
With less than 24 hours to go until Filament's launch:

We're delighted to announce that:
[h3]
Korean has also been added to Filament!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/fca07372a4a41ccd96ea20ed964ad6c3aeb23d8a.jpg[/img]

It will have subtitles & interface with English audio, akin to the existing languages mentioned, ready to use tomorrow!

With thanks again to MapleWhispering. 

Don't forget to join us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/filamentpuzzle]Discord[/url] where we will be having a small ceremony & launch celebration at 2.30pm BST tomorrow!

tags.feature: Korean has also been added to Filament!

notes.title: Filament: 2 new languages added
notes.content:
[h3]Well would you look at that. [/h3]

[h2]Filament's launch is just two days away![/h2]

[h3]And that's not all. [/h3]

[h2]We have added 2 new languages! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/a9baa263e28599fd9ac886857f1ab9354f18ee3c.png[/img]

[h3]On Thursday, you'll be able to play Filament in:

- Traditional Chinese
- Japanese[/h3]

[h3]As well as the Simplified Chinese, Russian, French & German languages. 

All the above languages will have subtitles & interface with English audio.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35631314/b8aa5e0818ae34df2cdb70fbd4955468c9addced.jpg[/img]

[h3]We'd like to thank [url=https://twitter.com/MapleWhispering]Maple Whispering[/url] for assisting us with the localisation & we look forward to Filament's launch day very soon. [/h3]

[h3]Over & Out![/h3]

tags.feature: On Thursday, you'll be able to play Filament in: - Traditional Chinese - Japanese
